name: Curlew Community Food Pantry
notes: Free food; no SNAP purchase required. Serves North Ferry County. Walk-ins; closed holidays. Not open every Thursday. Alternate contact: 509-846-3138. Call to confirm.

name: Danville Outpost
notes: General store with groceries; located in Danville, outside ZIP 99118. SNAP retailer listed by USDA. Closed Sunday.

name: Ferry County Co-op
notes: In Republic, outside ZIP 99118. Winter hours start first Monday in October. Summer hours differ, including Sunday opening; call to confirm. No membership required to shop. Closed New Year's Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.

name: Essentials General Store
notes: SNAP-authorized general store. Hosts Orient Food Pantry as a separate free service. Retail hours unverified; pantry hours must not be treated as store hours.

name: People's Pantry of Ferry County
notes: Free food distribution; no SNAP purchase required. Serves Ferry County and Wauconda residents. Visit in person; call to confirm.

name: Orient Food Pantry
notes: Free food distribution; no SNAP purchase required. Pickup at Essentials General Store. Serves Orient and surrounding area. Pantry hours differ from retail store hours.

name: Kettle Falls Community Chest & Food Pantry
address: 472 S Meyers St, Kettle Falls, WA 99141
notes: Free food distribution; no SNAP purchase required. Located in neighboring Stevens County. Confirm service-area eligibility and travel access by phone.

name: Keller Senior Meal Site
notes: Eligibility-restricted: Colville Reservation seniors 55+; nutrition assistance may also serve adults 18+ with disabilities. Call to confirm eligibility, meal costs and availability; not an unrestricted free meal site.
